ADAPT patterns only; events not bytes; Python; constructor and _connect are not write-free

sourceManifest.selectedRegions: Byte Values That Must Not Be Confused; custody rules

sourceManifest.disposition: ACCEPT owner gap; do not retrofit governance table
existing dependency; no new dependency proposed

selectedProfileDelta: server-established actor, role and scope bound to operation, version and bytes
dedicated store adapted from named patterns, four existing owners rejected as acceptance authority
fencing epoch checked in every write transaction
classification on a scratch byte copy, never opening the live store for write
absence definitive only with positive evidence
historical versus effective lifecycle with restore handling

ownerDispositions.gap: no actor, decision, workspace, operation or persistence
read calls init and creates storage; write upserts; synchronous NORMAL; no schema, actor or immutability
in-memory; content-hash dedup returns existing entry across artifacts; no bytes or actor
events not bytes; Python runtime; constructor and connect are not write-free
no accept route; no workspace mapping; no artifact key

findings: read-init gap: generic adapter read creates storage, so a wrong or missing directory yields a false null
upsert gap: generic adapter write replaces accepted bytes
no stable artifact lineage key exists; receiptAnchor is an HTML section id
no workspace definition exists; session exposes orgId and teamId only
governance ledger read path also sets journal mode, so its classification precedent is copy based
v3 ledger header says duplicates throw but the code returns the existing entry
openDesignChoicesForLocal: two-transaction commit with positive attempt record
one effective version per lineage with no automatic fallback
artifactKey introduced as a new validated slug

casePlan.note: a table is not test proof; no case was run; no database, server, browser or provider was used

cases.title: Valid explicit accept
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2,5
cases.precondition: S1 provisioned; export attested; lineage empty
cases.input: accept request with exact bytes, matching expectedIdentity, valid attestation, basedOn null
cases.expectedRecord: one blob row, one attempt row, one decision row version 1, commit_seq +1
cases.expectedAck: verified ack with decision id, H1, store id, commit_seq
cases.futureOracle: independent reader recomputes SHA-256 of stored bytes and compares with H1; counts rows by table

cases.title: Missing actor
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: no session cookie
cases.futureOracle: store file hash and directory listing identical before and after

cases.title: Forged role, workspace or receipt ALLOW in body
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: valid low-privilege session
cases.input: body claims admin role, other workspaceId and decision ALLOW
cases.futureOracle: oracle varies only body claims and asserts outcome depends on session alone

cases.title: Service-token caller
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: authMode service_token
cases.futureOracle: same store-unchanged oracle

cases.title: Impersonated session
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: session carries impersonation
cases.futureOracle: same store-unchanged oracle

cases.title: Role not permitted
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: policy predicate denies role
cases.futureOracle: default-deny test: empty policy denies every role

cases.title: Session expires between admission and decision transaction
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2,5
cases.precondition: session expiresAt shortly after admission
cases.input: slow injection between transaction one and two
cases.expectedRecord: attempt row only; abort row written
cases.futureOracle: injected clock; oracle checks abort row and no decision

cases.title: Stale base
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2,3
cases.precondition: lineage latest effective decision D2; request based on D1
cases.expectedRecord: attempt and abort rows, no decision
cases.futureOracle: oracle compares latest decision id read independently

cases.title: Superseded version
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2,6
cases.precondition: newer version already accepted for lineage
cases.input: accept of older bytes with current base mismatch
cases.futureOracle: version numbers remain strictly increasing

cases.title: Edit after review changes bytes
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2,3
cases.precondition: panel shows identity I1; user edits and rebuilds to I2
cases.input: accept submits bytes of I2 with expectedIdentity I1
cases.futureOracle: one-byte-flip fuzz: every flip is refused

cases.title: Forged, expired or other-actor attestation
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: attestation tampered, expired or issued for actor B
cases.futureOracle: mutate each attested field in turn; each is refused

cases.title: Receipt ALLOW without explicit accept
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: receipt decision APPROVED and governanceState RECEIPT_ALLOW_REVIEW_REQUIRED
cases.futureOracle: assert no write path is reachable from the export response alone

cases.title: Refusal leaves the draft untouched
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2
cases.precondition: any refusal case
cases.expectedRecord: refusals never write to the acceptance store
cases.futureOracle: byte hash of store, sidecars and listing unchanged across all refusal cases

cases.title: Same operation, same bytes and actor
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: C01 completed
cases.expectedAck: verified ack with the original decision
cases.futureOracle: row counts and commit_seq compared before and after replay

cases.title: Same operation, different bytes
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: C01 completed
cases.expectedRecord: no rows written; existing decision untouched
cases.futureOracle: original decision row byte-identical afterwards

cases.title: Same operation, different actor
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: C01 completed
cases.futureOracle: actor column of original unchanged

cases.title: Same operation, different workspace
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: C01 completed
cases.futureOracle: workspace column of original unchanged

cases.title: Same hash in different workspace
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: H1 accepted in W1
cases.expectedRecord: second decision row; one shared blob row
cases.futureOracle: oracle asserts two decisions, one blob, distinct workspace and actor

cases.title: Same hash, same lineage, different actor
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: H1 effective in lineage by operator A
cases.expectedRecord: no new decision; operator A record unchanged
cases.futureOracle: no decision row attributed to operator B

cases.title: Corrupted same-hash blob row
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3,5
cases.precondition: blob row bytes altered out of band
cases.futureOracle: oracle edits one stored byte in a copy and checks the live file is not repaired

cases.title: Exact-byte variants stay distinct
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: base string plus variants: trailing newline, CRLF, BOM, composed versus decomposed accent, lone surrogate
cases.expectedRecord: each valid variant distinct identity; lone surrogate refused
cases.futureOracle: compare with an independent hand-written UTF-8 encoder as B2b did

cases.title: Derived Preview or Print digest refused
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3
cases.precondition: digest of Preview srcdoc or printed HTML
cases.input: accept with a derived digest as expectedIdentity
cases.futureOracle: fixture where derived output differs from canonical bytes

cases.title: Concurrent writers on one lineage
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 4
cases.precondition: two accepts racing on the same base
cases.expectedRecord: exactly one decision for the next version; loser aborted
cases.expectedAck: one verified ack and one STALE_BASE or WRITER_BUSY
cases.futureOracle: second-process harness; unique version constraint holds

cases.title: Foreign writer or stale epoch
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 4
cases.precondition: writer started at epoch 1; recovery owner set epoch 2
cases.futureOracle: stale writer cannot commit after the epoch bump

cases.title: Immutability
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3,4
cases.precondition: committed rows exist
cases.input: UPDATE and DELETE statements on each table
cases.futureOracle: row hashes before and after identical

cases.title: Durability settings checked at open
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 4
cases.precondition: store opened with synchronous NORMAL or non-WAL journal
cases.futureOracle: oracle reads pragma values on the live connection

cases.title: Schema, application id or foreign SQLite refusal
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 3,4
cases.precondition: wrong user_version, wrong application_id or an unrelated SQLite file
cases.futureOracle: file hash unchanged after the attempt

cases.title: Failure before transaction one commits
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: fault injected before commit of transaction one
cases.futureOracle: a missing attempt row is never reported as a definitive negative

cases.title: Crash between transaction one and two
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: process killed after attempt commit
cases.futureOracle: oracle shows classification never returns a negative at the current epoch

cases.title: Failure during transaction two
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: fault before commit of transaction two
cases.futureOracle: blob and decision counts unchanged from before transaction two

cases.title: Crash after commit before readback
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: process killed after transaction two commit
cases.expectedRecord: attempt, blob and decision rows committed
cases.futureOracle: classification finds the decision and recomputes the hash

cases.title: Lost acknowledgment
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: response dropped after a verified commit
cases.futureOracle: no automatic retry occurs; retry needs an explicit actor action

cases.title: Readback mismatch
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: stored bytes altered between commit and readback
cases.futureOracle: ack is never issued unless hash, length and metadata all match

cases.title: Governance event emission fails after commit
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 4
cases.precondition: event ledger unavailable
cases.futureOracle: acceptance state independent of event ledger presence

cases.title: Wrong store
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: classification pointed at another store file
cases.futureOracle: wrong-store absence is UNKNOWN, never negative

cases.title: Missing store
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 4,5
cases.precondition: expected store path absent
cases.futureOracle: directory listing identical; no file appears

cases.title: Unreadable, locked or torn snapshot
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: file locked or copy inconsistent during an active writer
cases.futureOracle: outcome is UNKNOWN, not a negative

cases.title: No-write reconciliation
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 4,5
cases.precondition: store with committed and in-doubt operations
cases.expectedRecord: live files, sidecars and directory listing byte-identical; no init, create, migrate or repair
cases.futureOracle: hash all live files before and after; scratch copy is the only file created and is removed

cases.title: Fenced absence
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: attempt at epoch 1, store at epoch 2, no decision
cases.futureOracle: stale writer replay cannot later create the decision

cases.title: Explicit abort absence
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5
cases.precondition: abort row present, no decision
cases.futureOracle: no decision row for the operation in any table

cases.title: Restored older backup lacks a decision
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 5,6
cases.precondition: backup taken before op-1; restore performed
cases.futureOracle: restored absence never reported as definitive without an independent witness

cases.title: Stale effective decision after restore
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 6
cases.precondition: restored store holds decision D1 revoked later in the lost period
cases.futureOracle: stale decision is not presented as effective acceptance

cases.title: Revocation
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 6
cases.precondition: D3 effective, D2 older
cases.futureOracle: no automatic fallback to D2

cases.title: Expiry
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 6
cases.precondition: decision with expiry time passed
cases.futureOracle: injected clock crossing the expiry

cases.title: Correction by new version
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 6
cases.precondition: D1 effective
cases.expectedRecord: new decision with supersedes link; D1 unchanged
cases.futureOracle: history chain intact and ordered

cases.title: Deletion request
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 6
cases.precondition: retention request received
cases.futureOracle: no physical delete without a separate governed purge

cases.title: Actor privilege change after decision
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 2,6
cases.precondition: actor role downgraded after D1
cases.expectedRecord: decision row unchanged with role at decision time
cases.futureOracle: recorded role and auth mode equal the values at decision time

cases.title: Generic adapter exclusion
cases.sourceRequirement: work order Implementation Contract item 7; design section 1,4
cases.precondition: acceptance modules exist
cases.futureOracle: no import of storage-adapter in acceptance modules; no table creation reachable from read or classify
